comfyUpdate.repairNeeded: The last update did not finish; ComfyUI needs to be put back.
comfyUpdate.repairTitle: Put ComfyUI back the way it was
comfyUpdate.repairDescription: Moves your models and settings back to the previous copy of ComfyUI and restarts that version. It takes a few minutes.
comfyUpdate.restoreDescription: Puts the kept copy of ComfyUI {{target}} back in place of {{installed}}. ComfyUI stops for a few minutes while it switches over.
comfyUpdate.updateDescription: Downloads ComfyUI {{target}} from GitHub and its Python packages from PyPI. ComfyUI stops for a few minutes while it switches over. If anything fails, it switches back to {{installed}} by itself.
comfyUpdate.repairTooltip: Put the previous copy of ComfyUI back and restart it
comfyUpdate.updateTooltip: Download ComfyUI {{version}} and switch to it
comfyUpdate.restoreTooltip: Put the kept copy of ComfyUI {{version}} back
